documents.name: Pc Minutes July 1
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the July 1, 2024 Sykesville Planning Commission meeting, presented for approval. No substantive cases heard; informational updates on ongoing projects.

documents.name: County Updates
documents.synopsis: Carroll County Bureau of Comprehensive Planning staff report for the August 5, 2024 PC meeting covering Water and Sewer fall amendments, Housing Study data compilation, and text amendments (Housing Expansion and Affordability Act, Solar Site Design Requirements).

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report for the August 5, 2024 Planning Commission site plan review for 7611 Main St. (Parcel 4454-6, B-L zone), a DSC-owned property converting the first-floor pottery center to two retail suites and an office. Staff recommends approval.

documents.name: Interior Layout Plan
documents.synopsis: Interior layout plan for the proposed 7611 Main St redevelopment showing the conversion of the first-floor pottery center into two retail suites and an office space for the DSC.

documents.name: Agenda
documents.synopsis: Planning Commission agenda for August 5, 2024. Business item: site plan review for 7611 Main Street (DSC change of use from pottery center to multi-use retail/office).

documents.name: Planning Commission Minutes - 2024-08-05
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the August 5, 2024 Sykesville Planning Commission meeting. Site plan for 7611 Main Street redevelopment (pottery center to multi-use retail/office) approved unanimously. Town updates: Joy Property in final review stage; Enclave at Parkside resubmitted stormwater plans contingent on Parkside at Warfield. Next PC meeting moved to Tuesday Sept 3 due to Labor Day.
